record.title: Shalamcheh security suspension and same-day passenger restoration, April 2026
record.scope: Trade and passenger suspension at Shalamcheh after a nearby strike
record.direction: Both crossing functions; precise directional exceptions not established.
record.movement: Passenger and commercial movements initially suspended.
record.exceptions: Passenger traffic restored later that day; first resumed freight movement not established.
record.enforcement: Authority suspended crossing operations and reported restored passenger handling.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no assumption of continuation to the research cutoff.
record.official_rationale: Authorities described suspension after strikes hit the Iranian side; a protective security purpose is inferred from that context, not quoted as an explicit rationale.
record.context: A strike on the Iranian-side passenger hall prompted the Iraqi suspension.
record.uncertainty: Most official claims derive from INA; Reuters adds security-source reporting. Later passenger restoration does not establish the freight endpoint or exact hours.
